name: flexpwm_stepper
description: Hardware-timed STEP/DIR stepper driver for Teensy 4.x: one FlexPWM submodule per axis generates the pulse train, the reload ISR counts steps (with the Cortex-M7 dsb double-trigger guard) and stops bounded moves on the exact count. Honors the JMC iHSS60 DIR setup/hold timing. Shared by firmware/tuner-controller (production HAL, hal/motor_teensy41.cpp) and firmware/t41-stepper-test (bench rig).
